Satellite NanoConnect-2 (SAI-1, NANOCONNECT-2/SAI-1)
Type CubeSat

Launched 2021-02-28
NORAD ID 47701
Deployer Mercury [Maverick]
Launcher PSLV
Organization UNAM (National Autonomous University of Mexico)
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Headquarters Mexico
Operator In-house?
Oneliner

Educational mission to demonstrate spacecraft subsystems in space.
Description

The NanoConnect-2 aims to test flight computers, their power, monitoring systems and verify that mechanical structures are working properly. Monitoring data will arrive at Terrena Station, locatedon the premises of the Institute of Nuclear Sciences in Ciudad Universitaria.
Notes

SpaceAI has a SDR payload onboard.
